fields.name: isBoss
fields.description:
The looming boss node — suppresses the site / affiliation, and the
incarnation title stands in as the guide name.

fields.name: sceneArt
fields.description: The scene hero art (the dreamscape scene, or Limbo for the boss).

fields.name: figureArt
fields.description:
The character render standing on the right (the guide, or the boss); null
for a guideless place (the starter).

fields.name: placeName
fields.description: The place name (dreamscape, or "Limbo").

fields.name: guideName
fields.description:
The resident guide's name, or the boss incarnation title; null for the
starter.

fields.name: siteName
fields.description:
The signature site's display name (e.g. "Dream Augury"); null for the
starter / boss.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The site bonus, starter blurb, or boss incarnation description.

fields.name: affiliation
fields.description: The dreamscape's affiliation name; null for the starter / boss.

AtlasMap.name: stageWidth
AtlasMap.description: The fixed design canvas the stage scales to fit (letterboxed).

AtlasMap.name: nodes
AtlasMap.description: Placed nodes, laid out by the view model along its layer axis (starter to boss).

fields.name: view
fields.description: Presentational data for the {@link AtlasNode } face.

fields.name: card
fields.description: The InfoCard reveal content shown while this node is pressed / hovered.

AtlasMap.name: onEnterNode
AtlasMap.description: Enter a node's dreamscape; fired on a tap / click of an available node.

AtlasMap.name: stageRef
AtlasMap.description: Screen root the node reveals anchor + clamp against (viewport coordinates).

fields.name: left
fields.description: Stage-space centre of the node (1920x1080 coordinate system).

fields.name: size
fields.description: Rendered node diameter in stage pixels.

fields.name: isReachable
fields.description:
Whether the player can still reach this node from where they now stand.
Only an explicit `false` fades the node (drawing it as a dimmed, unrevealed
frame — its builder already blanks the icon and badges); omitting the field
renders the node normally, which suits the design-system demos that show a
lone node in isolation.

fields.name: iconRef
fields.description: The dreamscape icon art as an {@link ArtRef}, or `null` while unrevealed.

fields.name: siteBadgeGlyph
fields.description: The signature-site badge {@link Glyph}, or `null`.

fields.name: knownDreamsignRef
fields.description: The pre-revealed known dreamsign icon as an {@link ArtRef}, or `null`.

fields.name: badgeScale
fields.description:
Multiplier applied to the site / dreamsign badge sizes (the mobile atlas
enlarges them). Defaults to 1 — the desktop size.

AtlasNode.name: hovered
AtlasNode.description: Draws the node in its revealed/hover glow + scale-up state.

AtlasNode.name: rootRef
AtlasNode.description:
Ref to the node's root element, so a caller can anchor an input-adaptive
press-reveal (InfoCard) to it and measure it against the stage. Typed as the
common `HTMLElement` because an available node renders through `Pressable` as
a `<button>` while an unreachable one is a plain `<div>` — the caller only
measures the element, so it needs neither concrete tag type.

AtlasNode.name: onEnter
AtlasNode.description:
Mouse/focus reveal driver: fired with the node id when the pointer or
keyboard focus enters the node. Optional — a caller driving the reveal
through the pointer handlers below omits it.

AtlasNode.name: onLeave
AtlasNode.description: Paired with {@link onEnter}: fired on mouse leave / blur.

AtlasNode.name: onClick
AtlasNode.description: Activation: fired with the node id on click and on Enter / Space.

AtlasNode.name: onPointerEnter
AtlasNode.description:
Input-adaptive press-reveal handlers, wired to the node's root so the
InfoCard engine (`usePressReveal`) can reveal on touch press-down and on
fine-pointer hover. A caller either wires these OR the {@link onEnter} /
{@link onLeave} mouse pair, never both.

AtlasNodeReveal.name: item
AtlasNodeReveal.description: The placed node and its reveal content.

fields.name: view
fields.description: Presentational data for the {@link AtlasNode} face.

fields.name: card
fields.description: The InfoCard reveal content for this node.

AtlasNodeReveal.name: stageRef
AtlasNodeReveal.description: Screen root the reveal anchors + clamps against (for popover placement).

AtlasNodeReveal.name: onEnterNode
AtlasNodeReveal.description: Enter a node's dreamscape; fired on a tap / click of an available node.

Button.name: size
Button.description: Height/scale. 'lg' is the taller commit height ("Begin Your Dream") — commit is a size, not a variant.

Button.name: full
Button.description: Stretch to fill the container width.

Button.name: disabled
Button.description: Dims the button and detaches its click/press feedback.

Button.name: cost
Button.description:
Appends an inline price, e.g. cost={100} -> "… 100◆", rendered in the
button's own on-accent white so the price reads as part of the label. The
currency is set by `costKind` (default essence).

Button.name: costKind
Button.description:
Which currency the `cost` is denominated in — essence, energy, spark,
points, or counter. Picks the shared economy-spec price mark (bx-crypto /
bx-fire-alt / bx-sparkles / bx-star-circle / bx-hourglass); the mark stays
on-accent white. Default essence. Ignored when `cost` is null.

Button.name: onClick
Button.description: Fires when the button is activated (no-op while disabled).

Button.name: ariaLabel
Button.description: Accessible label when the visible content is a bare price with no text.

Button.name: label
Button.description:
The button's text label. Resolve any UUID/name to a plain string before
passing it — the button renders copy, never arbitrary caller markup. Omit
only for a price-only button (supply `ariaLabel` instead).

CardGalleryPanel.name: subtitle
CardGalleryPanel.description: Optional intro line under the title.

fields.name: testId
fields.description:
A `data-testid` for selecting the button in tests.
A `data-testid` for selecting the disc in tests.

CardGalleryPanel.name: emptyLabel
CardGalleryPanel.description: Empty-state copy shown when `cards` is empty.

CardGalleryPanel.name: frame
spacing
CardGalleryPanel.description: Internal padding and grid gap scale. Defaults to `regular`.

CardGalleryPanel.name: largeCards
CardGalleryPanel.description: Draw each tile with GameCard's larger readable type scale.

CardGalleryPanel.name: testId
CardGalleryPanel.description: Test id for the panel root.

CardGalleryPanel.name: cutoutAwareAccessory
CardGalleryPanel.description:
When a screen-cutout box is known, float the accessory beside the device
island instead of sharing the header row.

CardGalleryPanel.name: onCardPress
CardGalleryPanel.description: Fires when an enabled card tile is activated.

CardGalleryPanel.name: endAction
CardGalleryPanel.description: Optional card-sized action appended after the cards.

fields.name: entryId
fields.description: Stable action id reported through `onEndActionPress`.

fields.name: glyph
fields.description: Large glyph that carries the action's visual identity.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Accessible action label.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Small uncontained line rendered directly below the glyph.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Detach interaction and visually recede the action.

fields.name: testId
fields.description: Optional stable test id on the action button.

CardGalleryPanel.name: onEndActionPress
CardGalleryPanel.description: Fires with the appended action's stable id when it is activated.

CardStatOrb.name: value
CardStatOrb.description: Displayed value (string so callers can pass `"X"` for variable cost).

CardStatOrb.name: sizeVar
CardStatOrb.description: CSS length for the square orb diameter (e.g. `var(--cv-energy-orb-size)`).

CardStatOrb.name: numberSizeVar
CardStatOrb.description:
CSS length for the digit size — the single-digit ceiling, which doubles as
the digit box edge (e.g. `var(--cv-energy-orb-font-size)`). Multi-digit
values auto-shrink below this to fit.

CardStatOrb.name: numberCapPx
CardStatOrb.description:
Upper bound (px) for the digit auto-shrink search. The displayed size is
the smaller of the CSS digit ceiling and the fitted size, so this only
needs to sit at or above the rendered digit size.

CardStatOrb.name: tooltip
CardStatOrb.description: Optional hover tooltip: a short plain-language description string.

CardStatOrb.name: tintColor
CardStatOrb.description:
Tint applied to the digit when the stat has been changed by a
transfiguration (e.g. a bumped spark or halved energy cost). Only the number
picks up the tint; the resource glyph behind it keeps its resource hue so a
changed stat still reads as the same kind of resource.

CardTermDefinitions.name: text
CardTermDefinitions.description: The rules text to scan for glossary terms.

CardTermDefinitions.name: testId
CardTermDefinitions.description: Optional test id for the stack container.

CardTermDefinitions.name: side
CardTermDefinitions.description: Which side of the card the panel sits on, exposed for layout/tests.

CardView.name: selectionColor
CardView.description: The selection-ring {@link TangoColor}. Default the `"selected"` role.

CardView.name: transfiguration
CardView.description:
When set, paints the card as transfigured: a small colored gem follows the
name, the changed corner stat(s) take the tint, and only the added/changed
rules text is tinted (driven by the descriptor's marked text). The card
itself should already carry the transfigured stats and rules text — pass the
`card` and `display` from `buildTransfigurationDisplay` together.

fields.name: color
fields.description:
Light tint for the name gem, changed stat orb(s), and changed text. A
`#${string}` hex, matching Tango's `HexColor`.

fields.name: markedText
fields.description: Rules text with the changed/added spans wrapped in transfigure markers.

fields.name: energyChanged
fields.description: True when the energy cost changed (Empowered); tints the energy orb.

fields.name: sparkChanged
fields.description: True when the spark changed (Kindled); tints the spark orb.

fields.name: fastChanged
fields.description: True when the card gained Fast (Hastened); tints the speed bolt.

CardView.name: large
CardView.description: Use larger text sizes for rules text, name, type line, and stats.

CardView.name: figment
CardView.description:
Render the figment frame (rules §Figments): no energy orb, the spark floats
as a large mark in the top-right corner instead of inside a name bar, and
the rules box takes a black-on-light frosted treatment. A figment has no
name bar by default; pass `figmentTitleBar` to show one (for a named figment
like a Legionnaire, or while its name is being edited).

CardView.name: figmentTitleBar
CardView.description:
In figment mode, render the top title bar holding the card name (left
aligned, dark character-card treatment). Ignored when `figment` is false.

CardView.name: hideRulesText
CardView.description: Hide rules text for dense card surfaces that show identity and stats.

CardView.name: slots
CardView.description: Optional editor wrappers for individual rendered card slots.

CardView.name: onRulesFontSizeChange
CardView.description:
Called with the rules-text font size (in px) the auto-shrink fitter
computed to fit the rules box, whenever it changes. The card editor uses
this to drive its font-size overlay and font-size sort.

CardView.name: onBoxTopFracChange
CardView.description:
Called with the rules text box's top as a fraction of card height (null when
the card has no rules box or it is not yet measured), whenever it changes.
The art-crop editor uses this to floor zoom-out and pan against the same
box-relative safe area the card renders with.

CardView.name: eagerRulesFit
CardView.description:
Measure the rules-text fit immediately instead of deferring until the card
nears the viewport. The card editor sets this while sorting by font size so
every card reports a stable fitted size up front; without it the sort would
reshuffle endlessly as off-screen cards measured only after being moved.

CardView.name: rulesTextboxExpanded
CardView.description:
Grow the rules text box to a taller editing height. The card editor sets
this while its rules-text field is open so the inline textarea has room to
show and edit several lines at once instead of being clipped to the
three-line display cap.

DreamcallerPortrait.name: dreamcaller
DreamcallerPortrait.description: The dreamcaller whose art and identity the portrait shows.

fields.name: portraitFocus
fields.description: Normalized head position used to center subject-aware crops.

DreamcallerPortrait.name: variant
DreamcallerPortrait.description:
Framing: self-framing `hero` / `panel` / `thumb`, or the full-bleed stage
fills `standing` (desktop column) and `fullBleed` (mobile carousel).
Default `panel`.

DreamcallerPortrait.name: size
DreamcallerPortrait.description:
Fixed pixel width. Panel/thumb stay square, so this also sets their height.
A sized portrait never shrinks in a flex row. Omit to fill the container
width. Ignored by `standing`/`fullBleed`, which fill the caller's stage.

DreamcallerPortrait.name: profile
DreamcallerPortrait.description: Semantic Dreamcaller profile represented by this portrait. Omit for decorative art.

DreamcallerPortrait.name: onActivate
DreamcallerPortrait.description: Optional activation for selectable profile portraits.

DreamcallerPortrait.name: unavailable
DreamcallerPortrait.description: Keeps the profile readable while suppressing activation.

Dreamsign.name: dreamsign
Dreamsign.description: The dreamsign to show. Identified by `id` (never by name).

Dreamsign.name: sizePx
Dreamsign.description: Square tile edge length in pixels.

Dreamsign.name: testid
Dreamsign.description:
Override the tile's `data-testid`. Defaults to `"dreamsign-art-tile"` so the
shipped shop / reward / deck-viewer selectors keep working.

Dreamsign.name: onPress
Dreamsign.description: Fired on a tap / click that was not a deliberate hold-to-read.

Dreamsign.name: unavailable
Dreamsign.description: Keeps details readable while suppressing selection.

Dreamsign.name: variant
Dreamsign.description:
The tile's material. `"flat"` (default) is the chrome-free collectible tile
used in lists over a solid surface; `"hud"` composes {@link DS_SHADOW} — a
drop-shadow + violet glow — into the tile filter so the object lifts off busy
scene art in the transparent quest HUD. `"revelation"` uses a stronger
path-following shadow for large choices over bright Revelation site art.

EssenceValue.name: tone
EssenceValue.description:
Color role. `value` (default) paints the amount and glyph in the essence
violet; `inherit` takes the surrounding text color, for a value that sits
inside a button or other control whose label color already reads.

GameCard.name: model
GameCard.description: Canonical card semantics and resolved display snapshot.

fields.name: cardId
fields.description: Stable catalog UUID used for reveal identity and diagnostics.

fields.name: displaySnapshot
fields.description: Complete resolved display data whose `id` matches `cardId`.

fields.name: transfiguration
fields.description: Optional presentation of a transfigured card.

GameCard.name: onActivate
GameCard.description: Player action invoked by a quick activation.

GameCard.name: unavailable
GameCard.description: Whether the action is unavailable while the card remains informative.

GameCard.name: selectionColor
GameCard.description: Selection-ring color. Defaults to the shared selected role.

GameCard.name: large
GameCard.description: Use the larger card typography preset.

GameCard.name: hideRulesText
GameCard.description: Hide source rules on dense surfaces; the reveal stays complete.

GameCard.name: figmentTitleBar
GameCard.description: Render a title bar on a named figment.

GameCard.name: testId
GameCard.description: Optional stable test id for the semantic source.

GlassBackdrop.name: children
GlassBackdrop.description:
Optional content lifted above the frost. Childless, the backdrop is a bare
`aria-hidden` decorative layer; with children it hosts them over the frost.

GlassButton.name: label
GlassButton.description: The button's text — a resolved string shown in the control typography.

GlassButton.name: onPress
GlassButton.description: Fires when the button is activated (no-op while disabled).

GlassButton.name: glyph
GlassButton.description: Optional leading glyph painted as a `GlowIcon` before the label.

GlassButton.name: cost
GlassButton.description: Optional inline essence cost rendered after the label.

GlassButton.name: widthReservations
GlassButton.description:
Possible dynamic label/cost states. The button reserves the widest state
while rendering only the current one, preventing surrounding layout shift.

GlassButton.name: variant
GlassButton.description: Surface treatment: neutral glass (`default`) or red danger glass.

GlassButton.name: placement
disabled
GlassButton.description: Detaches the click / press feedback and marks the button `aria-disabled`.

GlassButton.name: testId
GlassButton.description: A `data-testid` for selecting the button in tests.

GlassDialog.name: title
GlassDialog.description: The dialog's heading, rendered as an `<h2>`.

GlassDialog.name: subtitle
GlassDialog.description: Optional intro line under the title.

GlassDialog.name: onClose
GlassDialog.description: Dismisses the dialog; fires when the close disc is activated.

GlassDialog.name: closeLabel
GlassDialog.description: Accessible name for the close disc. Defaults to `"Close"`.

GlassDialog.name: cutoutAwareClose
GlassDialog.description:
When true, on a full-bleed mobile overlay whose screen-cutout box is known
(a device-screenshot mock-up) the close disc floats up beside the device
island instead of sitting on the header row, so the header title clears the
safe area below it. No effect on desktop or on real hardware (where the
island geometry is not exposed). Defaults to `false`.

GlassDialog.name: wide
GlassDialog.description:
On desktop, widen the panel and trade the `85vh` height cap for explicit
viewport padding so a roomy grid fits in two rows without internal scroll.
No effect on the full-bleed mobile overlay. Defaults to `false`. A caller
gates this on its own roomy-desktop media query.

fields.name: term
fields.description:
Canonical term shown as the popover heading. The term itself is matched
directly (case-insensitively), so it does not need to be repeated in
`variants`.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: Short, plain-language definition.

fields.name: variants
fields.description:
Extra word forms that should match this entry beyond the term itself, such
as plurals and past-tense forms (e.g. `banes`, `transfigured`). Omit when
the term is the only form. Matching is case-insensitive.

GlossaryTerm.name: entry
GlossaryTerm.description: Canonical glossary meaning owned by this inline source.

fields.name: term
fields.description:
Canonical term shown as the popover heading. The term itself is matched
directly (case-insensitively), so it does not need to be repeated in
`variants`.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: Short, plain-language definition.

fields.name: variants
fields.description:
Extra word forms that should match this entry beyond the term itself, such
as plurals and past-tense forms (e.g. `banes`, `transfigured`). Omit when
the term is the only form. Matching is case-insensitive.

GlossaryTerm.name: text
GlossaryTerm.description: Authored word form preserved in the surrounding sentence.

GlossaryTerm.name: emphasized
GlossaryTerm.description: Optional emphasis inherited from the rules-text renderer.

GlowIcon.name: color
GlowIcon.description: Fill {@link TangoColor} — Boxicons paints via the element's text color.

GlowIcon.name: size
GlowIcon.description:
Rendered width/height as any CSS length. Defaults to `1em` so an inline
glyph tracks the surrounding text size. The icon's own `font-size` is
pinned to this value so the `em`-based glow and outline scale with it.

GlowIcon.name: glowFilter
GlowIcon.description: Emitted-light bloom {@link MediaFilter}. Omit for no glow.

GlowIcon.name: shadow
GlowIcon.description: When true, adds the soft content-protection shadow beneath the glow.

GlowIcon.name: title
GlowIcon.description: Accessible label; the icon is hidden from assistive tech when unset.

GroupPanel.name: children
GroupPanel.description: The grouped content laid out inside the pane.

HoverPopover.name: children
HoverPopover.description: The element that triggers the popover on hover.

HoverPopover.name: content
HoverPopover.description: The popover body. Rendered into a portal when visible.

HoverPopover.name: delayMs
HoverPopover.description: Delay before showing the popover (ms). Defaults to 500ms.

HoverPopover.name: placement
HoverPopover.description:
Preferred side to anchor the popover relative to the trigger.
- `"top"` (default) centers the popover above the trigger and flips to
  the bottom when the trigger sits near the top edge of the viewport.
- `"left"` anchors the popover to the left of the trigger and flips to
  the right when the trigger sits near the left edge of the viewport.
  Useful for triggers on the right edge of the viewport (e.g. the
  right-side deck sidebar) where the popover would otherwise appear
  detached above or below the row.

In both cases the popover is shifted along the perpendicular axis as
needed so it stays fully inside the viewport.

HoverPopover.name: maxWidthPx
HoverPopover.description:
Override the popover's max-width cap (px). Defaults to 260px, which
suits short explanatory blurbs. Pass `null` to disable the cap entirely
when `content` is a self-sizing element such as a card preview.

HoverPopover.name: triggerAs
HoverPopover.description:
The DOM element type for the trigger wrapper. Defaults to `"span"` for
inline use within text. Pass `"div"` for block-level triggers.

HoverPopover.name: triggerLayout
HoverPopover.description:
Trigger wrapper layout. `inline` preserves flowing text; `inlineFlex`
shrink-wraps icon/orb triggers without adding a baseline line box.
Defaults to `inline`.

IconButton.name: glyph
IconButton.description: The glyph painted centered in the disc (e.g. `GLYPHS.close`).

IconButton.name: label
IconButton.description: The disc's accessible name (`aria-label`); the disc shows only its glyph.

IconButton.name: onPress
IconButton.description: Fires when the disc is activated (no-op while disabled).

IconButton.name: disabled
IconButton.description: Detaches the click / press feedback and marks the disc `aria-disabled`.

IconButton.name: placement
ariaExpanded
IconButton.description:
When the disc is a disclosure trigger, its `aria-expanded` state (whether
the surface it controls is open). Omitted for a plain action button.

IconButton.name: testId
IconButton.description: A `data-testid` for selecting the disc in tests.

InfoCard.name: variant
InfoCard.description: Which media treatment. Omit — or pass 'text' — for the text variant.

InfoCard.name: image
InfoCard.description:
The media the card is built around, as an {@link ArtRef}. Required.
The square hero image the card is built on, as an {@link ArtRef}. Required.
The scene hero image the card is built on, as an {@link ArtRef}. Required.

InfoCard.name: imageCrop
InfoCard.description:
How the media is cropped. Default `"top"`.
How the hero image is cropped. Default `"center"`.

InfoCard.name: imageFilter
InfoCard.description:
A named media {@link MediaFilter} (e.g. a drop-shadow for a transparent object).
A named media {@link MediaFilter} (e.g. a spark glow).
A named media {@link MediaFilter} for the scene image.

InfoCard.name: frame
InfoCard.description: true = framed portrait, false = contained transparent object. Default false.

InfoCard.name: title
InfoCard.description: The card's headline. Plain text — resolve names before display.

InfoCard.name: body
InfoCard.description: The reveal copy, as a {@link RichText} value (plain / rules / note / stack).

InfoCard.name: figure
InfoCard.description:
An optional foreground character render (a transparent full-body cutout —
a Dream Guide, the boss) laid centered and prominent OVER the hero image,
standing above the glass text card. Its own subject of the card; omit for a
scene-only hero. An {@link ArtRef}, resolved by the component.
Optional transparent full-body figure standing on the card's right side.

InfoCard.name: meta
InfoCard.description:
Small mono/uppercase overline above the title, on the glass card.
Small mono/uppercase overline above the title.

InfoCard.name: subtitle
InfoCard.description:
An epithet under the name — a smaller serif line in white, mirroring the
Dreamcaller-select name/epithet pairing. Plain text; resolve before display.
The resident guide / boss title under the place headline.
An epithet under the name — a smaller serif subtitle in white, mirroring
the Dreamcaller-select name/epithet pairing. Plain text; resolve before
display.

InfoCard.name: glyph
InfoCard.description: The {@link Glyph} the disc renders. Required.

InfoCard.name: tide
InfoCard.description: Which of the five tides. Fixes the disc color/mark and the alignment label.

Motes.name: on
Motes.description: Toggles the layer on/off. Renders nothing when false.

Motes.name: tint
Motes.description: Context tint: 'warm' over scene art (default), 'violet' over chrome.

Motes.name: count
Motes.description: Particle density — how many motes to render.

Motes.name: seed
Motes.description: Offset the deterministic layout so two Motes layers differ.

Motes.name: zIndex
Motes.description: Stacking order within the positioned parent.

PipBadge.name: variant
PipBadge.description: Which pip this is — picks the fill color.

PipBadge.name: value
PipBadge.description: The displayed value (string so callers can pass `"X"` for variable cost).

PipBadge.name: size
PipBadge.description:
`"sm"` matches the small card stat row; `"md"` matches the larger
`large` card variant in `CardDisplay`. Sizes are tuned so the number
stays readable but the badge does not overpower adjacent text.

PipBadge.name: scale
PipBadge.description: Multiplier for card renderers that need the pip to follow card text scale.

PipBadge.name: ariaLabel
PipBadge.description:
Optional accessible label for screen readers. If omitted, the badge
uses a sensible default for its variant.

PipBadge.name: tooltip
PipBadge.description:
Optional hover/focus tooltip. When provided, the badge becomes its own
hover anchor. A short plain-language description string.

PressInfo.name: card
PressInfo.description: The InfoCard (or any node) to reveal while pressed/hovered.

PressInfo.name: holdStillClicks
PressInfo.description: true = a touch hold still fires the child's click (menu / UI toggle).

PressInfo.name: pressFeedback
PressInfo.description:
Press motion for the trigger. `stationary` is reserved for readable rules
copy that must hold its authored size while definitions are visible.

Pressable.name: as
Pressable.description: Element or component to render. Default 'button'.

Pressable.name: disabled
Pressable.description: Disables press feedback and pointer handlers, and shows the default cursor.

Pressable.name: pressFeedback
Pressable.description:
Press motion. `scale` is the global control treatment; `stationary` is
reserved for readable rules-copy reveal surfaces. Default `scale`.

Pressable.name: children
Pressable.description: Content rendered inside the pressable element.

QuestStatusBar.name: stageRef
QuestStatusBar.description: Ref to the screen root (position:absolute inset:0 in the scaled frame). Required.

QuestStatusBar.name: essence
QuestStatusBar.description: Essence total shown in the HUD.

QuestStatusBar.name: dreamsigns
QuestStatusBar.description: The dreamsigns to dock (a small set inline; more collapse to a stack + viewer).

QuestStatusBar.name: deck
QuestStatusBar.description: Deck size (used in the deck button's aria-label).

QuestStatusBar.name: onViewDeck
QuestStatusBar.description: Open the deck viewer — fired on a tap / click of the deck sprite.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable Dreamcaller UUID.

fields.name: portrait
fields.description: The portrait art as an {@link ArtRef}. Required — a docked Dreamcaller always has art.

fields.name: portraitFocus
fields.description: Normalized head position used to center the square HUD crop.

QuestStatusBar.name: size
QuestStatusBar.description:
HUD size. `compact` (default) is the mobile / touch size; `grand` is the
larger desktop size the dreamscape screen picks above the wide-viewport
breakpoint.

ResourceChip.name: kind
ResourceChip.description:
Which economy value: essence, energy, spark, points, counter. Rendered as
the parent's filled-Boxicon mark (bx-crypto / bx-fire-alt / bx-sparkles /
bx-star-circle / bx-hourglass), colored by role.

ResourceChip.name: value
ResourceChip.description: The numeric value to show. Omit to render the mark alone.

ResourceChip.name: size
ResourceChip.description: Inline scale — sm (13px) / md (16px, default) / lg (20px).

ResourceChip.name: chip
ResourceChip.description: Render as a solid pill badge (for HUD/over-art) instead of inline text.

ResourceChip.name: spacing
ResourceChip.description: Gap between value and mark — tight (0px, default) or loose (4px).

ResourceChip.name: entity
ResourceChip.description: Semantic resource represented by this chip; makes the named chip self-revealing.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable domain identity of this resource source.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Display title for its reveal.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Player-facing explanation.

SegmentedControl.name: options
SegmentedControl.description: Segments to render: plain strings (value === label), or `{ value, label }` pairs.

SegmentedControl.name: onChange
SegmentedControl.description: Fires with the newly-selected segment's value when the user switches.

SegmentedControl.name: full
SegmentedControl.description: Stretch to fill the container width, each segment sharing it equally.

Select.name: options
Select.description: The choices shown in the menu.

Select.name: onChange
Select.description: Fires with the newly-selected value when the user picks a menu item.

Select.name: leadingGlyph
Select.description:
Leading glyph drawn at the start of the trigger — the control's identity
(a filled funnel for a filter, filled up/down arrows for a sort). It stands
in for a text label, keeping the trigger to a single font.

Select.name: full
Select.description: Stretch the trigger to fill the container width.

Select.name: align
Select.description:
Which trigger edge the menu aligns to. 'start' (default) opens flush to the
leading edge; 'end' opens flush to the trailing edge — use it when the
Select sits against the right side of a bar so the menu stays on-screen.

SiteNode.name: model
SiteNode.description: The placed-site model — position, label, glyph, and state.

fields.name: isBattle
fields.description: This site is the dreamscape's guardian battle.

fields.name: isLocked
fields.description: A battle gated behind the dreamscape's other, unvisited sites.

fields.name: isInteractive
fields.description: Clickable: not visited and not locked.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Display label (battle tier / `Draft Nx` / site type name).

fields.name: blurb
fields.description: One-line mechanic blurb shown in the reveal.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: The site {@link Glyph}.

SiteNode.name: motion
SiteNode.description: Enable the calm floaty drift (disabled under reduced-motion via CSS).

SiteNode.name: onSelect
SiteNode.description: Enter the site; fired on a tap / click of an interactive node only.

SpeechBubble.name: text
SpeechBubble.description: The spoken line. Plain text; the component supplies the bubble voice.

SpeechBubble.name: arrowSide
SpeechBubble.description: Which side carries the arrow pointing toward the character.

SpeechBubble.name: testId
SpeechBubble.description: Optional stable test id for product-screen QA.

TideDisc.name: tide
TideDisc.description: Which of the five tides. Fixes the disc's color and glyph.

TideDisc.name: id
TideDisc.description: Stable id (a tide deck id) for the `data-tide-disc` QA hook.

TideDisc.name: label
TideDisc.description: Display name used by the source and its tide card.

TideDisc.name: description
TideDisc.description: Semantic description revealed by this tide source.

TideDisc.name: size
TideDisc.description: Which enumerated {@link TideDiscSize} to render. Default 'sm'.
